name: Goth Kid
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve black/purple fringe, pale face, distressed long black coat, chains/crosses, cargo trousers, platform boots and headphones. Review headphone identity, sudden sound cutoff, cyan background and title.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Goth Kid — Dead Air.
IDENTITY: exact pale young male goth character with shaggy black hair and purple fringe, dark eyeliner, ear piercings, black/purple over-ear headphones at the neck, distressed layered black hoodie and long torn black coat with purple lining, black cargo trousers, silver chains and cross details, and heavy buckled platform boots. Preserve the reference's restrained annoyed expression and complete outfit.
0–0.7s: full-body arms-crossed stance. A small red-orange jagged sound-wave symbol hovers annoyingly beside his ear, rattling with a harsh non-musical electronic buzz. Without enthusiasm, he raises his headphones onto his ears.
0.7–2.5s: camera rockets backward as a COLOSSAL spectral pair of black-and-violet headphone cups appears thirty feet apart around an enormous expanding red sound-wave shape. The phantom cups rush together with crushing speed while his coat billows and his body stays centered between foreground effects. They stop just outside his silhouette and squeeze the entire red waveform into one tiny bright dot, an immense vacuum-pressure impact ring expanding outward. At the exact impact, the loud accelerating buzz and rush CUT TO COMPLETE SILENCE. Massive visual contact hold with no fullscreen black, no environment and pure cyan visible between all forms.
2.5–3.5s: snap close to his bored face, then settle into a complete hero composition. Exact title DEAD AIR slams below his face in two chunky comic lines with one deliberately muffled, low title thud. Phantom cups shrink into his ordinary headphones.
3.5–5s: he folds his arms again. One tiny escaped red sound-ripple makes a brief squeak; he pinches it between two fingers without looking and it vanishes instantly, cutting the squeak off. Silent deadpan hold, coat settles, stable title. No spoken shushing, vocals, music, digital scenery, shadow-filled background or opaque manga panel.
